probe_timing_allocation: For terminal stage r, pass the nested stage prefix and alpha=.05*prefix_stage_count/3/family_heads. Thus every interval retains the full three-stage Bonferroni allocation, including shorter timed runs.
target: Supplied physical low-minus-high write sources and shared h only; output before current write, no model/codec/trace reconstruction. B3 independent-write K plus exactly the same signed2c; B4 coherent Kdiag plus2c.
mask_scope: Per-fixture/per-head top8 is an objective diagnostic, not a TRAIN-aggregated calibration mask or deployed policy.
timing: Fresh process per method; identical fixture and SciPy/NumPy imports; one untimed warmup then3 full-API timings. Includes repeated input checks and exactc within probe API, excludes process startup/load/serialization. All samples retained; no extrapolated end-to-end calibration claim.
memory: Linux process peak RSS after load and after measured work, high-water increase, input bytes, and API-declared core workspace; core workspace excludes allocations/transients/imports and is not peak memory.
confidence_scope: One predeclared probe seed on this fixed real trajectory; observed interval inclusion is a check, not empirical coverage-rate evidence. Conditional Gaussian intervals across supplied128rows and3stages; no FP64 rounding-error proof and no across-run95% claim unless family_heads was predeclared accordingly.
no_selection: No speed-based promotion without exact mask/certificate; no method/seed/chunk/tolerance tuning or repeated-seed coverage experiment.
failure_policy: First mismatch/nonfinite/timeout is retained and ends this frozen run; no silent retry or substitute numbers.
codec_scope: Selected LEGACY_P_PRE GPU-generated FP32 codec/anchor and FP64 physical subtraction/response; TRAIN associative-recall0/layer0/head0 only; not full-training or deployment-mask evidence.
